name: Sailor
description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years. In that time, you faced down mighty storms, monsters of the deep, and those who wanted to sink your craft to the ocean's floor. Your first love is the distant line of the horizon, but the time has come to try your luck on land.

feature.name: Ship's Passage
desc: When you need to, you can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. You might sail on the ship you served on, or another ship you have good relations with (perhaps one captained by a former crewmate). Because you're calling in a favor, you can't be certain of a schedule or route that will meet your every need. Your DM will determine how long it takes to get where you need to go. In return for your passage, you and your companions are expected to assist the crew during the voyage.

traits: My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.
I work hard so that I can play hard when I get to port.
I enjoy sailing into new ports and making new friends over a flagon of ale.
I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
My language is as foul as an otyugh's nest.
I like a job well done, especially if I can do it myself.
ideals: Respect. The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)
Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)
Freedom. The sea is freedom — the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)
Mastery. I'm a master of my craft who wants to be better. (Any)
People. I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)
Aspiration. Someday I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)
bonds: I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.
The ship is my home and the crew are my family.
I'll always remember my first ship.
In a harbor town, I have a paramour whose eyes nearly stole my soul.
I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.
Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmate, and I want revenge.
flaws: I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
I can't help but pocket anything that looks like it could be valuable.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.
I'll wait until my comrades are asleep to steal their shares.
